svg.text: Construction — one yes drives unit → items → stages → merges → close row; planning reads the ledger, the review stage writes it
digest moves · session proposes · word approves · type runs the stages · merges one at a time · landing is an effect, not the close
a name on a row · no line
one at a time · fixed order
opens: all merged · gone: new unit
opens: gates red · bolt stays open
one set per stage · verdicts inside
yes → chore unit · last to run
no bolt of its own · no change directory
lands on the line it was raised on
written in the place · read as evidence
after the yes only a session's work and the next row wait — no stage is nudged; the ledger changes only when a session judged
